arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Bedrick argued the state must disclose reasons for strikes.
Mr. Schalit argued the challenger must prove a prima facie case.
Justice Kennedy questioned the rigor of the proposed standard.
Justice O'Connor asked if the standard relies on Title VII cases.

paragraphs: This case tests the standard for proving racial discrimination in jury selection. the side that brought the case argues the state must explain its strikes. The state argues the challenger must prove bias first.

paragraphs: This case defines the legal standard for detecting racial bias in jury selection. It determines how courts evaluate claims of discriminatory strikes. The outcome shapes the fairness of criminal trials nationwide.
